tutorial.html:
Checkers (Declarative)

Move diagonally, capture opposing pieces by jumping, and reach the far side to crown a king. Captures are mandatory and a capture chain must be completed.

Tap one of the highlighted legal destinations. Crowns, required captures, and continuing jumps are shown from the server view.
